_about: Every pre-registered strategy test and its verdict. The board renders this; the allocator funds nothing that is not a PASS here AND past the go-live gate. Add a row per results doc; never edit a verdict after the fact — add a new row.

tests.test: Model vs market (tennis bootstrap Elo, MLB Elo)
tests.result: Bootstrap tennis Elo Brier 0.2589 vs market 0.2024; MLB model adds nothing to the price (beta 0.065, t 0.20).
Resting orders fill when the price is about to move against them; adverse selection exceeds the spread.

tests.test: Kalshi exchange-wide price-only survey (taker + maker, 876 cells)
tests.result: 0 taker cells survive confirmation; every maker cell dies at the fill check.

tests.test: Weather nowcast (running max vs Kalshi dailies)
Kalshi liquidity incentive (LIP) rewards vs fill losses

tests.result: +2.75c at their own prices (t 3.2) but -2.2c one minute later; edge decays in ~5 s, 85% in-play.
Kalshi leads by ~3 s; following the jump loses in both directions.
-0.74c / +1.11c across the two halves; no confirmation.
MLB dead; ATP/WTA confirmation -0.89c, t -1.03 on 1,723 markets.

tests.test: Kalshi tennis vs sportsbook closing line
tests.result: Kalshi matches the book-average close (Brier 0.2008 vs 0.2003); the trade rule loses -1.5c / -5.3c per trade by half.

tests.test: Polymarket tennis vs sportsbook closing line (+ Kalshi same-moment)
tests.result: Polymarket matches the book close (Brier 0.2023 vs 0.2028, median 0.8c apart); 52 trades in 7 months; Kalshi and Polymarket identical at the same timestamp (1c median gap).

tests.test: Polymarket US calibration survey (baseball, tennis, table tennis; taker rules at T-30)
tests.result: Settle rate within ~1c of mid in every volume bucket; no taker cell passes both halves (tennis NO-on-longshots +3.8c only in the second half, first half negative); PM US and Kalshi 0.5c apart on the same tennis matches.

tests.test: House side of Kalshi sports combos (NO at the combo buyer's fill price, KXMVESPORTSMULTIGAMEEXTENDED)
tests.result: 15,224 settled combos (Aug 17-30): YES settled 20.1% at a 19.5c mean price; NO side -3.7% per $ net of taker fee, CI spans zero, confirmation half only 16 markets. Combo buyers on Kalshi are priced fairly; no house edge to quote for.

tests.test: Kalshi vs Polymarket US on the same games: complement arb, lead-lag, maker-on-PM-US/hedge-on-Kalshi (114 games, 20 s books, 60 min)
tests.result: No pre-game cross ever (best -1.4c/pair). In-play gaps are post-point latency (5 of 42 survive 20 s). PM US follows Kalshi (in-play beta 0.93 within 20 s, t 33; Kalshi never follows); pre-game the venues sit 1-2c apart with nothing to trade.

tests.test: Result 15 touch-maker on Kalshi's own tape (MLB, NHL, NFL, NCAAF, soccer; population baseline, test half)
tests.result: NHL PASS: +0.67c CLV/fill [+0.61, +0.71], return +2.0% on 41 test games. MLB/NFL/soccer CLV +0.65 to +1.12c with intervals above zero but realised return inconclusive; NCAAF spans zero. Queue-priority caveat stands: only the live $1 test measures fill share. A PASS here funds nothing by itself.
